description: The 20 AI-specific launch checks for an AI app (spending caps, rate limits, server-side keys, credit charging, version tags, records of which results worked first time, real cost per result, switching models safely). Returns the checks not yet done, each with why it matters and a request for a coding agent, plus one combined request.

done.description: Ids of checks already done. Ids: spend-cap, rate-limits, server-keys, capped-retries, provider-budget, every-call-charged, deduct-server-side, refund-failures, one-charge-per-request, output-metadata, versioned-regenerations, outcome-events, events-by-version, step-costs, wasted-spend, who-it-fails-for, prompts-in-git, switch-flags, replay-set, shutdown-plan.

group.description: Only checks in one group: cost (cost and abuse), charging (charging for ai use), traceability (a record of every ai result), signals (what worked, for whom, at what cost), change (switching safely)

name: launch_checklist

combinedPrompt.description: One message covering every remaining check, numbered; empty when none remain
